scope: Restore bundled aggregate field prefixes for ACIS, VISUALSTYLE and data storage types.
evidence: Scratch aggregate-initializer programs compile and run with bundled headers; before this change ACIS and data-storage forms failed to compile, while VISUALSTYLE silently read 0/false instead of 7/true. After field-order restoration all three probes pass.
Focused graph-preservation CTest covers old field prefixes, new-field defaults, nested 3D objects and VISUALSTYLE values; lc3_compat_check builds.
Current LibreCAD metadata source compiles with the current upstream headers.
Both focused data-storage bounds and schema-profile CTests passed after rebuilding.
limitations: Source-prefix checks do not prove binary ABI compatibility or general 3D/ACIS semantic support.
Native GUI, producer witnesses and hosted checks remain open.
